observed_anchors: The detached ClayVMTypedValueContract/v1 research candidate snapshots admitted mutable bytearray input by converting it to bytes and then binds a SHA-256 digest to the immutable snapshot.
The prior candidate admitted subclasses through isinstance(value, (bytes, bytearray)); Python special-method semantics allow bytes(obj) to invoke type(obj).__bytes__ when provided.

Current EntityOS whole-machine sandbox evidence remains unavailable because exact-current-main run 31938018528 retry job 95143236160 completed failure with steps=null; this is runner/infrastructure no-start evidence, not code evidence.
grf.generated_reality: A bytearray subclass can be admitted as if it were ordinary mutable byte storage while overriding __bytes__ to return data unrelated to its physical bytearray contents; the resulting OwnedBytes digest then authenticates the substituted representation rather than the underlying admitted source bytes.
grf.counter_reality: bytes(value) necessarily copies the underlying bytearray storage even for subclasses, so subclass admission cannot spoof the snapshot.
grf.falsifier: Create a bytearray subclass whose underlying storage is b'PHYSICAL' but whose __bytes__ returns b'FORGED'; pass it through the old OwnedBytes.snapshot path and compare physical storage, stored snapshot and digest verification.
grf.predicted_if_generated_reality: snapshot.data is b'FORGED' and digest verification succeeds over b'FORGED' despite underlying bytearray storage remaining b'PHYSICAL'.
grf.predicted_if_counter_reality: snapshot.data remains b'PHYSICAL' or admission fails.
grf.collapse: Generated reality supported; prior candidate form refuted for provenance-stable source admission.

unusual_experiment.name: BYTEARRAY_SUBCLASS_BYTES_OVERRIDE_SNAPSHOT_SPOOF
unusual_experiment.baseline: ordinary built-in bytearray snapshot copies current storage into immutable bytes and remains unchanged after later source mutation
unusual_experiment.intervention: bytearray subclass underlying b'PHYSICAL' overrides __bytes__ to return b'FORGED'
unusual_experiment.rollback: in-memory objects only; no external or persistent effect

candidate_fix.mechanism: At the Python reference boundary admit only exact built-in bytes, bytearray or byte-oriented memoryview using type(value) is ...; reject subclasses/unknown exporters before snapshot. Keep the resulting OwnedBytes payload exact built-in immutable bytes and reverify its digest at admission.
